description: Unrepresentative data or biased historical fraud labels cause worse outcomes for some groups. Likely without targeted testing, with major harm.
proposed_controls: Audit data coverage and labels; test subgroup errors; review proxy variables; retrain where thresholds are breached; independent fairness verification.
residual_notes: Serious group harm remains possible until validated.

description: Excess collection, reuse, retention or access to identity and financial data. Severe impact.
proposed_controls: Impact assessment (NDPA s.28); minimise data; set retention; encrypt; role-based access with logs; vendor terms.

description: Thin-file customers or those with access needs face disproportionate restrictions and weak redress.
proposed_controls: Review thresholds; alternative verification routes; accessible appeals with authority to reverse.

description: Unexplained adverse flags prevent customers and staff finding errors.
proposed_controls: Case-specific reasons; model documentation; decision logs; test explanation quality.

description: Overtrust, workload or lack of authority causes rubber-stamping.
proposed_controls: Mandatory review of adverse outcomes; training; evidence access; override authority; quality sampling.
residual_notes: Review is fallible; resourcing must be shown.

description: Changing transactions and fraud tactics raise missed fraud and wrongful flags.
proposed_controls: Monitor data and outcomes; validate updates; rollback and manual fallback.

description: Compromise, data poisoning or evasion of detection (NIST, 2023, p. 15). Fintech data is a frequent target.
proposed_controls: Least privilege; security and adversarial testing; input checks; protected logs; rehearsed response.

description: An identity or AI service fails or changes unexpectedly.
proposed_controls: Due diligence; change notification; monitoring; tested fallback (GOVERN 6.1, MANAGE 3.1).

description: Failure to meet NDPA duties on lawful basis, automated decisions (s.37), security (s.39) or breach notification (s.40), or later EU obligations.
proposed_controls: Obligations register; DPO oversight; legal review before launch; breach procedure tested.
